reviews.title: So Far, So Good
reviews.comment: I've used two of these motherboards in as many builds, and I've been happy thus far.  I've always found Asus boards to be reliable and have never encountered an issue with their build quality.  Both boards paired well with Ryzen 5700 chips (both X and G), with no need to update BIOS - they posted right out of the box.  Although it has WiFi, be aware you will probably need to have ethernet connection in order to initially download the appropriate WiFi driver.  Once done, it works flawlessly. The only concern one MIGHT have is the location of the GPU PCIE slot on the board.  IF one is using a 2.7 slot GPU in a microATX case, the bottom of the GPU winds up very close to the PSU shroud and I could see where GPU heating issues might arise.  The case I used has extra space below the last expansion slot so I haven't dealt with this.  Just something to consider.  All in all, it seems to be a fine board.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Works.
reviews.comment: worked for what I needed. Had to wait almost 3 weeks for prime delivery as it came from China. I would have went a different direction if I had known. I wish it had better placement of the PCIe lanes as I had to shift my plan to use 2 GPU's in my build (my fault). Would use again, better than any MSI B550 on the market (BIOS Flash).

reviews.title: Ideal AM4 DDR4 MB for either Windows or Linux
reviews.comment: Can't say enough good things about this MB it just runs rock stable with zero issues & easily over clocks. Ran windows 10 on it for a year & just now switched to Linux Cinnamon v22. Left the cpu & ram settings right where they were at (slightly oc'ed) again everything works great with & no issues and with Linux it's almost double the speed of Windows 10. if your looking to say good riddance to M$ and their ridiculous spyware game then this is a great choice.
reviews.author: John
